name: ribbon_01
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: stand-alone hand-painted 2D sprites for buff VFX in a Persona 5 Joker Slay the Spire 2 game mod. Match the visual vocabulary of the project's slash_thin and slash_cross sprites: sharply tapered brushwork; bright white specular cores, vivid scarlet rims near #E5191C, and sparse strands of rich burgundy and ink-black dry-brush marks. The game's shader reads luminance, so keep crisp, separated white, red, and dark values. Fine hand-drawn irregularity and soft antialiasing at the actual silhouette; no heavy cartoon outline, halftone, large flat color patches, flames, or black smoke. Use real RGBA transparency (alpha zero anywhere outside the asset); do not paint checkerboard, gray, white or black backdrops, mist or colored haze. No text, watermark, logo, characters, ground, frame, or axes.
Composition and canvas: Target 2048×512 pixels, ultra-wide landscape 4:1. Center the shape, keep it entirely within the central horizontal strip with about 3–4% clear side margins and 9–13% clear top and bottom margins on the intended 4:1 canvas. If a taller working canvas is used, put all visible artwork in one centered ultra-wide 4:1 strip and leave the extra space fully transparent.
Primary request: One lightweight scarlet silk ribbon left-wide right-thin, with a shallow flowing S and one gentle longitudinal twist. Clearly show a broad satin face and a thinner folded underside: reflective narrow white selvedge, white-white glints slipping along the folds, scarlet and dark-crimson changes in the cloth face, occasional tiny streaks of dry ink. Taper to a small fine end. This is the soft afterimage of an evasive sidestep, with visible fabric folds and absolutely no slash, blade, impact or flame.
description: 浅 S 形红缎丝带，一端宽、一端细，亮边勾出翻折。
processing: 仅去除多余透明留白，等比缩放后居中补透明画布至 4:1；保留柔和 alpha 边缘。 清零 alpha≤2 的边缘残点和全透明区域的 RGB；未做抠底。
